timestamp_semantics: monotonic logical append time after the Campaign197 terminal authority and all complete Campaign198 bounded repository checks
purpose: Freeze a finite software-product version, installed-base migration, support and patch, deprecation, retirement and compatibility lifecycle before source rows, product values, formulas, directions, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.bounded_search_scope: Existing Campaign160 and Campaign166-183 source-frontier metadata only
repository_evidence.campaign160_boundary: The no-credential source inventory does not admit a complete point-in-time software release, installed-version, migration, support, patch or compatibility history. A generic R&D, intangible, contract-liability or expense field cannot be substituted.
repository_evidence.campaign166_boundary: Campaign166 freezes cybersecurity incidents, privacy exposure and service outages. A vulnerability or outage is an operating shock; it does not identify the supported-version population, patch eligibility, deployment state or retirement transition before an incident.
repository_evidence.campaign167_boundary: Campaign167 freezes one-time product approval, commissioning and R&D milestones. A release announcement or general-availability date alone is a milestone and cannot substitute for a version-cohort stock-flow lifecycle.
repository_evidence.campaign168_boundary: Campaign168 freezes recurring customers, active users, installed footprint and utilization. Aggregate user or installation counts do not identify version, edition, deployment, migration, patch, compatibility or support-status cohorts.
repository_evidence.campaign169_boundary: Campaign169 freezes prices, fees, discounts and commercial terms. Subscription price, maintenance fee or upgrade price does not establish installed-version migration, patch compliance or end-of-support exposure.
repository_evidence.campaign170_boundary: Campaign170 freezes retention, churn, renewal, product migration and quality outcomes. Customer renewal or migration rates do not establish product-version identity, support eligibility, deployed patch level or compatibility state.
repository_evidence.campaign183_boundary: Campaign183 freezes legal software and technology-license rights, terms, support obligations, renewal and substitution. A license agreement governs rights; it does not identify the issuer's own-product release lineage, installed-version cohort, migration completion, patch deployment or compatibility matrix.
repository_evidence.sector_scope_boundary: Point-in-time software, cloud-service, embedded-software, device-platform and digital-product applicability plus listed-parent and product ownership must be frozen. Structurally non-software issuers may not be filled with zero or cross-sector ranked.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current release note, download dashboard, supported-version table or compatibility matrix cannot be projected backward without release, revision, adoption, migration, patch, deprecation, retirement, reinstatement, correction and first-public histories.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: software_product_version_edition_installed_base_adoption_upgrade_and_migration_cohort_stock_flow_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known version-cohort stock flow reconciling installed or active seats, devices, tenants or workloads across new activation, upgrade, downgrade, migration, rollback, retirement and closing supported-version populations by issuer-owned product and edition.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time source freezes listed parent, product, edition and semantic-version lineage; cohort opening and closing populations; activations, upgrades, migrations, rollbacks and retirements; first-public timing; corrections; and the complete 2019-2023 applicable denominator.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: supported_version_security_patch_eligibility_release_deployment_compliance_and_exposure_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known preventive maintenance state linking supported product versions and deployment cohorts to patch eligibility, release, rollout rings, installation, verification, deferral, rollback, exception and residual unpatched exposure before an incident.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete issuer-product-version history of patch identity, severity and prerequisites; eligible denominator; staged rollout and installation; exception, deferral and rollback; verification; correction; and trading-session availability without incident-outcome selection.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: software_product_deprecation_end_of_sale_end_of_support_retirement_compatibility_and_transition_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known product retirement state linking deprecation, end of sale, maintenance mode, end of standard or extended support, retirement, compatibility loss, successor availability and transition completion to affected installed cohorts.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source preserves product and version lineage, support tier and geography, announced and effective retirement dates, successor and migration path, dependency and compatibility graph, affected installed denominator, exceptions, reversals, corrections and first-public history across 2019-2023.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: release_announcement_general_availability_certification_or_launch_milestone_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A release announcement, beta, general-availability, certification or launch date relabelled as software lifecycle quality without installed-version or migration state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign167 already governs launch, approval, certification and R&D milestones. A single release event does not identify installed-version stock flow, support burden, migration completion or compatibility exposure.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: software_subscription_license_maintenance_fee_upgrade_price_contract_renewal_or_right_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A subscription, license count, maintenance fee, upgrade price, renewal, support obligation or legal software right relabelled as product-version lifecycle state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign169, Campaign170 and Campaign183 already freeze prices, commercial renewals and software-license rights. Those states do not identify version-cohort adoption, patch deployment, compatibility or end-of-support transition.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: cyber_vulnerability_outage_customer_user_installation_retention_or_product_migration_kpi_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A vulnerability, breach, outage, active-user count, installation count, retention, churn or aggregate product-migration KPI relabelled as software version and support lifecycle quality.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Incidents, aggregate adoption and customer outcomes are already frozen. They cannot reconstruct the product/version lineage, eligible installed cohort, patch level, support status or compatibility graph required here.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: product_version_edition_platform_deployment_channel_patch_severity_support_tier_direction_threshold_age_window_subset_or_combined_model_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A selected product, version, edition, platform, deployment channel, patch severity, support tier, direction, threshold, age, window, subset, normalization, interaction, combined score or fitted model from unadmitted histories.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing favorable products, versions, editions, platforms, channels, severities, support tiers, directions, thresholds, ages, windows, subsets, weights, interactions or models before every base history is admitted would multiply hypotheses and exploit product survivorship.

listed security, listed parent, product owner, developer, distributor, cloud operator, embedded-device maker, acquired product and successor mapping with ownership, consolidation and materiality history without current-state leakage

product and version taxonomy separating product family, edition, semantic version, release train, build, patch, firmware, cloud deployment, long-term support, maintenance mode, beta, general availability and retirement

release, general availability, activation, installation, upgrade, migration start and completion, rollback, patch publication and deployment, deprecation, end of sale, end of support, retirement, reinstatement, correction and first-public timestamps with trading-session availability

opening and closing installed or active cohort counts plus activations, upgrades, downgrades, migrations, rollbacks, retirements, device replacements, tenant or workload moves and denominator reconciliation without favorable omission

patch identity, affected and fixed versions, prerequisites, severity, eligible installed denominator, rollout ring, deployment, verification, deferral, exception, rollback and residual-exposure semantics before any incident outcome

support tier, geography, customer class, standard versus extended maintenance, service-level obligation, end-of-support policy, paid exception, transition assistance and successor availability history

customer, tenant, device, seat or workload cohort identity and privacy-safe aggregation with trial, duplicate, dormant, disconnected, unsupported, legacy, migrated and decommissioned semantics

missing, confidential, suppressed, staged rollout, pending verification, partial deployment, disputed, recalled patch, rollback, not applicable, structural non-software issuer, true-zero installation, migration and patch semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full applicable issuer-product denominator, delisting, acquisition, product transfer and discontinuation coverage, pagination, parser, identity, timing, unit, cohort-stock-flow, version-lineage, compatibility, applicability and source-acceptance tests using no factor, comparator, security-price or return values

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Three distinct version-cohort migration, preventive patch-deployment and deprecation-support-compatibility states remain deferred at source admission; release milestones, pricing, renewal, license-right, incident, adoption, customer-outcome and premature operator or model search are closed before values.
